what: Each capability provisioned, then record_provisioned() re-runs its catalog verify check against local Floci before recording it. record_provisioned_seconds is that server-side re-check.

results.verify_command: K=__gate_check__/$(date +%s%N); echo gate-check-$K > /tmp/__gate_check__.txt && aws s3 cp /tmp/__gate_check__.txt s3://launch-proof-uploads/$K && aws s3 cp s3://launch-proof-uploads/$K /tmp/__gate_check_out__.txt && cmp -s /tmp/__gate_check__.txt /tmp/__gate_check_out__.txt && aws s3 rm s3://launch-proof-uploads/$K
results.founder_message: Done and verified: Lets people upload and store files (like photos), and get them back later.

results.provision_command: aws dynamodb create-table --table-name launch-proof-records --attribute-definitions AttributeName=id,AttributeType=S --key-schema AttributeName=id,KeyType=HASH --billing-mode PAY_PER_REQUEST
results.verify_command: K="gatecheck-$(date +%s%N)" && aws dynamodb put-item --table-name launch-proof-records --item "{\"id\":{\"S\":\"$K\"}}" > /dev/null && aws dynamodb get-item --table-name launch-proof-records --key "{\"id\":{\"S\":\"$K\"}}" | grep -q "$K" && aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name launch-proof-records --key "{\"id\":{\"S\":\"$K\"}}"
results.founder_message: Done and verified: A place to save and look up structured information, like user profiles or orders.

results.verify_command: FROM=$(aws ses list-identities --query 'Identities[0]' --output text) && aws ses send-email --from "$FROM" --destination "ToAddresses=test@example.com" --message "Subject={Data=Verification check},Body={Text={Data=test}}"
results.founder_message: Done and verified: Sends an email to a user, like a confirmation or welcome message.
